title: Hearty Malted Italian Rocket Risotto
description: A malty, glassy-jelly risotto infused with fresh rocket, dairy‑free and energizing for any Italian meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add finely chopped onion and minced garlic, sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in malted barley flour and arborio rice, coat evenly and toast until edges lightly golden, about 2 minutes.
Pour in 1 cup oat milk, stir to create a thick, glassy base, and let it absorb for 2 minutes.

Gradually add vegetable broth 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding the next, continuing until the rice is creamy and al dente, about 18 minutes.
Whisk in balsamic vinegar, lemon zest, sea salt, and black pepper, then reduce heat to low and fold in fresh rocket until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 3 minutes to set; during this time the risotto will thicken into a silky, jelly‑like consistency.
Serve hot, spooning generous amounts onto plates, optionally drizzle with a touch of olive oil; enjoy the malty, energizing flavor.
